turns.text: ok can u edit a text to my sister pls. she works nights and wants to do phở breakfast tmrw morning after her shift and i dont really want to commit lol
Happy to help! Paste your draft and tell me what you'd like it to come across as, and I'll tweak it so it doesn't read as a flat no.

ok my draft: "hey i cant do phở at Phở Bến Thành tmrw, sorry. maybe another time"

it sounds kinda harsh.. i have chem at 11 on thursdays so timing is tricky. kenji gives me a ride home on thursdays so im free after chem tho. i wrote maybe later but can u keep it vague, like dont make me promise a day

Here's a softer version that keeps things open without locking in a date:

"hey! tmrw morning is tricky with chem at 11, but i really want to do phở at Phở Bến Thành with you 🫠 maybe later this week or next? i'll let you know when i've got a free window"

If you'd like it even looser:

"aw i want phở!! tmrw's tough bc of chem at 11, but let's do it soon, i'll text you when my schedule settles"

I left out the ride from Kenji and being free after chem, since you'd rather not pin down a day. Want it shorter, or a bit warmer?
first one is perfect, thank u!! ☕
Glad it works! Hope the phở happens soon. Good luck with chem!
